title: Test a narrow effect-integrity interchange across Runner, WIP, and DriftGuard
claim: Project Runner, WIP, and DriftGuard retain distinct native execution/recovery/control state machines, but exact producer experiments plus one source-agnostic Discovery observer now show that a neutral effect-attempt envelope can eliminate downstream source-specific parsing for normalized phase/retry reporting while preserving target/precondition binding, post-effect uncertainty, receipts, and native authority boundaries.

consumers.role: current M6 producer of neutral GitHub mutation effect envelopes
operation-journal producer of neutral effect envelopes
behavioral reload decision and downstream acknowledgement tracking without claiming behavioral recovery

preserved_boundaries: Project Runner remains owner of work graph, dispatch, budgets, backend capability, target authority, leases, and completion semantics.
WIP remains owner of workspace recovery cadence, checkpoint history, continuation surfaces, and ambiguous-effect recovery workflow.
A shared contract may define mechanical fields/states but may not make either repository authoritative over the other.

DriftGuard remains owner of drift evidence admission, reload decisions, acknowledgement acceptance, restore-anchor advancement, and behavioral-recovery claim ceilings; a caller acknowledgement may not be normalized into verified recovery.
promotion_evidence: Project Runner work-unit schema blob 65fd4f1af1812c280cbec0726a55b61b6ff02e76 defines execution status independently from WIP operation events.
Project Runner GitHub backend blob 833915398626c091a5df1dcc96504a7a12e7325f binds expected head/blob preconditions and post-write readback.
Project Runner verification blob e4f0453404013cbfe26882ea4805ae2fb3ce25aa uses VERIFYING, COMPLETE, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, and SUPERSEDED after backend execution.
WIP operation-event schema blob 66f9b5103e9ecc114feb9cb8fa6cebdc34082c2d defines PREPARED, ATTEMPTED, VERIFIED, FAILED, AMBIGUOUS, and RECONCILED with expected precondition and effect receipt.
WIP HEAD schema blob 7f94e4ea2358926fb3f2bf248cd3cb7600e246cd provides generation concurrency independently of Runner lease fencing.
DriftGuard R4 adapter blob 2904452b0f14a444c28a616e2e8963bab0f05ac6 maps native reload-required evaluations to PRE_EFFECT and accepted reload acknowledgements only to POST_EFFECT_UNVERIFIED.
DriftGuard adapter regression blob 2e205d299d440e8d9531246b3eb8fc94fe03cf48 proves the adapter cannot promote acknowledgement to POST_EFFECT_VERIFIED and does not mutate the native ledger.
DriftGuard exact-head hosted run 35510133549 passed the adapter and full native suite on both Ubuntu and Windows.
Project Runner producer head a32dc6987145c826d9ff3afe4b21eb95b1801ba9, adapter blob 8ae6ea3810326df09e5baacf5d4727a432a6d8c9, passed hosted workflow run 35512057107.
WIP producer head b53075e44b35704ff8e20cbcf87888359f8a80ee, adapter blob fb7cd88bfe38b2c0de78133e75f28b2ac9bbf4cd, passed hosted workflow run 35511962748.
DriftGuard producer head 976f50ca391560d16ebcdcfe478df28b1cd1efca, adapter blob 2904452b0f14a444c28a616e2e8963bab0f05ac6, passed hosted workflow run 35510133549 on Ubuntu and Windows.
Discovery observer blob 67dd00cc1c96120151ffa4eb38dc9d3893802ada derives the V0 contract from the schema and contains no current producer-specific parser branches.

Discovery observer regression blob b484631b1e78bdc62d23ba388a54e89f7668d19e proves the same observer accepts Project Runner, WIP, DriftGuard, and an unknown future source without registration/code changes.
Discovery observer exact source head 1869424dcd8d9d53e725e1a30d5339c07903830e passed Discovery validation run 35512241403 and composed lifecycle run 35512241220.
rejection_conditions: The proposed common contract requires Project Runner-specific scheduling semantics.
The proposed common contract requires WIP-specific workspace/checkpoint lifecycle semantics.
Adapters needed to share the contract exceed the duplicated implementation removed.
A common state vocabulary creates ambiguity between execution completion and recovery reconciliation.
Either project loses a viable standalone path.
Supporting DriftGuard requires mapping an accepted reload acknowledgement to POST_EFFECT_VERIFIED or otherwise claiming behavioral recovery not established by the native source.
The neutral envelope becomes an input to DriftGuard decision, acknowledgement, retry, or restore-anchor logic.
A third consumer can serialize into the envelope but no duplicated translation, recovery, or custody implementation is actually removed.

critical_objections: The broad shared execution/recovery/control state-machine hypothesis remains rejected; source-native authority and lifecycle semantics are intentionally not normalized.
One downstream observer now eliminates source-specific parsing, but the producers still own latest-event selection and native evidence construction.
Three producer adapters add maintenance surface; net portfolio maintenance reduction has not been measured against the parsing they replace.
A shared runtime library remains premature. The current evidence supports an interchange contract and one generic observer, not mandatory runtime coupling.
Future schema evolution could reintroduce adapter churn; compatibility cost needs a separate measurement before PROVEN_REUSABLE.

notes: Three exact producer branches have hosted PASS at their bounded adapter scopes.
One exact Discovery observer has hosted PASS with no current-producer-specific parsing and accepts an unknown fourth source without code changes.
Broad shared state machine remains rejected; producer-owned latest selection remains required; net portfolio maintenance value remains unmeasured.
Candidate remains EXPERIMENTING. PROVEN_REUSABLE is not justified.
